label: CUSTOM-OPTIMUS LIVE-MODEL practice run (not an official scorecard)

endpoint.transport: 3 retries, 2/4/8 s backoff on 429/5xx/network; non-retryable statuses terminal
endpoint.verification: PONG-verified before launch (GET /models 200 listing glm-5.3; one-chat PONG, finish_reason stop)
endpoint.credentials: resolved at runtime from the two PowerShell helpers; never logged or written to artifacts

productionPath.wiring: summarizer 'live' + ROT2_LIVE_* env (W26 pattern ported verbatim; content-identical to W26's working copy modulo line endings)
productionPath.pipeline: prepare_compaction -> compact -> append_compaction -> SessionManager restore, delta-append sessions

slice.rule: dev-side instances of the committed repo-level split with 4..12 gold items and 1200..9000 gold content chars; within language ordered by blake2b('contextbench|w27-live-slice|w27.1|' + instance_id); languages round-robin by descending candidate count; never touches the holdout
slice.note: 26 (not 30) after the invalidated first attempt consumed part of the wire-call budget; the 26-slice is a prefix of the same deterministic order

arms.B: task-state-ledger: production compaction, taskState prompt (protected task-state ledger on); substitutes W10's offline arm B (jev-relevance), which the compaction surface cannot express
arms.matched: identical transcripts, seeds, budgets and cycle structure; only taskState differs

cycles.chunking: reads split into 4 near-equal chunks, one chunk appended per cycle, compaction after each append
cycles.budgets: reserveTokens = max(200, 0.30 x estimated transcript tokens), keepRecentTokens = max(60, 0.10 x estimated), harness estimator chars/4 + 0.6 per message

wireCalls.note: the first main attempt ran blind transcripts (the W10 row loader dropped problem_statement); stopped after 15/60 pairs, invalidated, documented in README section 5

evaluation.metrics: W10 mirror (research/context_rot_r2/contextbench/): evaluate_task per record, summarize_arm aggregates, compare_arms paired exact sign test + Wilcoxon signed-rank normal approximation
evaluation.patchSuccess: UNAVAILABLE in every record (needs checkouts + f2p harness)
evaluation.editloc: gold-patch fallback (records carry no model patch); arm-independent by construction

dataHygiene: committed artifacts carry instance ids and numbers only; gold annotations, transcript contents, summaries and credentials stay in the gitignored runs/ tree
